title: Make acceptance-evaluation request tests independent of readiness-cache expiry
outcome: Acceptance request test fixtures always use their explicitly supplied readiness snapshot, even if delayed beyond the production cache TTL; they never probe the real machine to decide the expected evaluator.
acceptance: The new unsupported-parent request test and the existing provider/default-precedence test use deterministic fixture readiness independent of wall-clock scheduling and real provider installation.
A discriminating regression simulates an expired readiness timestamp or equivalent delayed read and proves the fixture selection remains deterministic without real-host readiness probes.
Production readiness expiration, invalidation and refresh behavior remain unchanged; no timeouts, skips, retries or weakened assertions are introduced.
